title: Regression pinning and candidate governance verification component
responsibilities: Execute the cross-language regression suite that pins accepted fixture and golden behaviour.
Verify CTest/pytest registration and record the candidate boundary and governance evidence.
state_ownership: none; the component holds no state and owns no runtime resource
concurrency: offline-single-threaded; one test process, no thread, no mutable shared state
errors: GoogleTest assertion failure or missing work product on a golden mismatch or an inconsistent record
deployment: repository-local test process and work products; no runtime deployment
rationale: Accepted behaviour is pinned at the exact candidate revision so a silent change fails the suite rather than being accepted.
